title: Insider trading using AI on all Street!!
author: hanyview
selftext:
20 years ago, any human worked with banks and offered "price of shares" information to others on the Wall Street stock market was charged with FRAUD for insider Trading. Today, AI does the same unscrupulous transactions to help the Billionaires get richer! Software theft and robbery are evasive means to avoid Law suits of FRAUD.
